semantic_verification.interpretation: Diagnostic same-image text similarity to 42 descriptions explicitly preferred within historical lexicon A/B pairs. Those are preferences, not adjudicated gold or cross-model rankings. Cosine is not a factual-quality score, is not used to rank models, and comparisons sharing an image are dependent. Exact key/hash/text matching, not embeddings, establishes annotation identity.
